question: Qualify the passive stow stop of the guarded pan: duty sign/force, allowable rotation, recovery, then replay custody and both recognized scores.

criterion.passIf: All 12 cases keep and score both pipes with >= 1.83 mm support and a non-negative reset margin, with the drive at the 30 A limit AND with the drive unpowered through receive and carry

evidenceClass: simulation only (coupled finite-contact pan sim + finite field-panel Java replay). No Fusion, no hardware.

methodsFollowed: docs/actuator-duty-review.md (powered travel / powered obstruction / power-loss holding; signed rotary gravity and stop work)
docs/mechanism-hardening.md + skills/frc-mechanism-hardening (fault and return, sensitivity, controls)
docs/loaded-transfer.md (custody to the receiver and recovery)
plugin.usedCode: scripts/hardening.mjs rotary (npm run mechanism:review -- rotary) for signed gravity holding and stop work

knownMissing.effect: battery-voltage (clocked_bus) step OPEN; removed in-memory as in fixed-path-01. Pan sim keeps its 9 V branch lower bound.

exploratory.dir: explore/ (preload boundary search with pan_stop.mjs; pan sims only, c=1.6 pads; made with an earlier pan_stop.mjs revision whose dynamics are identical and whose recovery summary differs)

reproduction.note: F0 instrumented harness reproduces every recorded run field and all 12 field rows exactly; instrumentation records only.

model.stop: unilateral spring-damper on +q past stow+gap: S = max(0, K d + C qdot), added to the pan equation in both the coupled pan sim and the Java return (advancePan)
model.preload: closing torque Tp*max(0, 1 + (q - 70 deg)/range) in both models; not in the controller feedforward
model.unpowered: motor torque forced to 0 from station feed (lip) to 0.3 s before tip start; controller loop keeps running; drive restored for tip and return
model.rigidHeld: pan forced onto the commanded trajectory; recorded external torque = holding demand
model.unchanged: finite pipe contact solver 7a921f81..., route schedules, gains 65/2.5/15 at 50 Hz, 30 A cap with 1.4 A reserve, 9 V branch bound, field solver, reset rule

dutyHeadline.signConvention: + closes the pan (+q, rotation past the 70 deg stow toward the rear wall); - opens toward dump. The passive stow stop can only react +q.
dutyHeadline.governingStopDirection: +q (closing). Gravity of the seated article (0.56 N m) and the carry inertial loads close the pan; the empty pan is nearly balanced at stow (-0.03 N m holding, CG 0.9 mm behind the pivot) and gravity reverses after only 6.7 mrad of opening (7.9 deg with a seated article), so an unpowered pan knocked open at the station falls toward dump.
dutyHeadline.commissioning13563: The recorded 13.563 N m is an OPENING (-q) station-impact spike (nominal trips, t=22.010/72.411 s, 10 ms mean -5.4 N m). A passive stow stop cannot react it without blocking the dump; drive + pan inertia carry it (baseline excursion -15.2 mrad, proposal -6.1 mrad powered / -7.3 mrad unpowered).

dutyTable.driveState: drive held (ideal rigid pose hold; external torque the drive+stop must react; stop itself unloaded)
drive at 30 A limit, no stop (registered baseline)
drive at 30 A limit, damped stop only
drive at 30 A limit, proposal (stop + 1.5 N m preload)
drive unpowered (power loss) from station feed to tip start - 0.3 s, proposal
drive unpowered, stop only (fails: knocked open, falls away)

stopProposal.function: Passive unilateral stow stop reacting +q (closing) at exactly the 70 deg commanded stow, plus a passive closing preload so the pan rests on the stop without power.
stopProposal.location: Two pads under the outboard (solid, |Y| ~100-155 mm, outboard of the 96 mm wall slot) portions of the slotted rear wall back face at local wall height ~100 mm from the floor plane; contact point ~(X 78, Z 522) mm at stow, outside the 82 mm feed half-width and below the article. Pads mount on short brackets rising ~40 mm from the transverse cradle near X=110 mm (not on the pivot towers; the 001 retrospective retired overturning tower feet). Lever arm about the pivot 100 mm.
stopProposal.contactGeometry: Flat-faced elastomer pad (~20 mm dia) against the flat wall back face; wall face normal at stow points (-0.34, -0.94), i.e. down/rear, so the pad pushes up/forward. The pan leaves the pads on opening (tip) and returns onto them at the end of the reset stroke.
stopProposal.material: High-loss viscoelastic elastomer (e.g. ether-based polyurethane or Sorbothane-class, loss factor ~0.5) bonded to a 3 mm aluminium backing, on aluminium angle brackets. A low-loss urethane is rejected by control C6.

compliance.basis: series pad + bracket stiffness assumed; replay sensitivity 2x softer (F4/F6) passes, low-loss pad (C6) fails reset

preload.profile: linear, falls to zero after 72 deg of opening (rangeRad 1.2566)
preload.embodiment: extension spring or elastic cord between a pan tab below the pivot and the cradle; uncompensated by the controller
preload.boundaryTested: 0.5 N m already held custody unpowered in exploratory runs (explore/); 0 N m fails (C2). 1.5 N m chosen for 3x margin; 5 N m saturated 30 A on adverse trips.
preload.tipCost: uses <= 1.5 N m of the 6.85-9.13 N m 30 A authority at tip start; adverse peak phase 29.60 A vs 29.62 A baseline

massEstimateKg.basis: 2 pads 10 g, 2 brackets 2x40 g, spring + anchors 30 g (estimate, not modeled)
massEstimateKg.context: commissioning.md heavy estimate is already 1.900 kg over R103; the stop must be offset elsewhere

stopProposal.loadPath: Pad reaction goes into the X110 cradle and sills rather than through the gearbox/tower; the pivot bearings see the equal and opposite force (<= ~102 N peak total).

custodyClosingQuasiStatic.basis: Article sits in the V formed by the floor (70 deg) and the rear wall (local direction 95.19 deg from the floor). Custody is retained while the wall still slopes down toward the corner.
custodyClosingQuasiStatic.status: geometric estimate; not replayed at the limit

gravityReversalOpening.basis: plugin rotary-holding reviewer (agent-frc 0.72.1 scripts/rotary-holding.mjs) on rotary/pan-rotary-model.json; opening beyond this angle lets gravity carry the pan further open with the drive unpowered

deliveryPoseOffset.leverBasis: 1.83 mm divided by the 345 mm pivot-to-article-centre radius at the floor exit (conservative rigid-lever bound, ignores re-tracking during the 1.6 s tip)
deliveryPoseOffset.conclusion: A persistent 4.36 mrad (0.25 deg) stop offset drops the minimum support to 1.799 mm, below the 1.83 mm criterion, and moves release 0.24 s earlier. The baseline has no headroom (1.828 mm). Set the stop contact at the commanded stow within +/-0.05 deg (0.9 mrad) and verify by replay; the proposal rests 0.32 mrad into the pads and keeps 1.830 mm.

controlsOutcome.stopAbsentUnpowered: C1: 0/12 - all four trips lost; pan falls closed (+q to ~3.1 rad) under article weight.
controlsOutcome.stopWithoutPreloadUnpowered: C2/C3: 0/12 - stop holds closing, but the station impact knocks the balanced pan open past the gravity reversal and it falls toward dump (-4.9 rad).
controlsOutcome.preloadWithoutStop: C4: 0/12 - preload drives the pan closed through stow.
controlsOutcome.stop2xCompliant: F4 unpowered 12/12 (77.0 ms), F6 30 A 12/12 (90.6 ms): 2x compliance does not lose custody; stop peak falls, settling slows (0.37 s vs 0.09 s after station impact).
controlsOutcome.lowLossPad: C6: 0/12 - pan keeps and releases both pipes but rebounds off a low-loss pad on the return stroke and never meets the 1 deg / 0.03 rad/s stow-dwell before the reset deadline.
controlsOutcome.stopOnly30A: F1: 6/12 - stop chatter during stow delays release 120 ms; both nominal trips reset after the deadline.
controlsOutcome.detection: The replay detects loss: every control without both elements loses all 12 cases; removing damping fails reset; a 0.25 deg gap fails the support criterion by 0.03 mm.

limits: One-plane rigid pan about a fixed pivot; stop is a lumped linear spring-damper (no pad nonlinearity, set, temperature or wear).
Power loss modeled as zero motor torque only; NEO 550 brake-mode, gearbox back-drive friction and controller reboot behaviour are not modeled (back-drive friction would help).
Preload is an ideal torque law; real spring geometry, hysteresis and attachment not designed.
The 12 cases are the registered set (2 scenarios x 2 trips x 3 field placements); no new field placements, peers or chassis tolerance cases.
Pad location and bracket are proposed from the analytic profile only; clash, sheet stock and cradle capacity are unverified in Fusion.
Custody closing allowable (3.8 deg adverse) is a geometric estimate; not replayed at the limit.
Reset margin loss of 18 ms vs baseline (71.8 ms min) is inside a margin that also must cover unmodeled disturbances (commissioning.md).
nextSteps: Physical: measure installed pan back-drive torque and NEO 550 brake/coast holding torque at stow, with and without the article.
Physical: bench-measure the candidate pad stiffness and loss factor (drop/rebound of the pan onto the pad from the return-stroke speed); require restitution <= ~0.4.
Physical: measure the station-feed opening impulse on the real pan (the -13.56 N m spike) and the stop reaction with a load cell or pad indentation.
Physical: power-loss test - cut pan power at station feed with an article and hold through a full carry route; confirm custody and recovery on re-enable.
Physical: verify stop contact angle vs commanded stow encoder zero within +/-0.05 deg; record the as-built gap.

Fusion (native, owner-coordinated slot): model pads, brackets and preload spring on the X110 cradle; run motion clash through stow, tip and return with the feed guides, and confirm the wall back face is flat solid stock at the pad patch.
Fusion: cold-mass the stop hardware against the mass budget and trace the pad reaction through the cradle/sill attachments (structural route).
Replay: rerun the battery-voltage stage once pan-duty-summary.json (fe048c0d...) is pushed; extend unpowered windows to carry-only and tip-onset brownouts.
pluginFriction: rotary-holding reviewer rejects a stop with zero free travel (freeRad must be nonzero), so a stop seated exactly at the registered pose cannot be expressed; the 0.25 deg gap case was used instead.
rotary-holding has no preload/spring element and no time-domain stop duty (impact peak, sustained window, rebound/settling); the coupled duty had to be built project-side.

actuator-duty-review describes powered/obstructed/power-loss duties for lifts, but there is no runnable rotary-stop duty fixture that consumes a recorded torque history with sign, peak and sustained windows.
